## Not guaranteed

Everything tagged "appearance, approximate" in the part, and every illustration choice. It is shown for looks only and is not checked against a catalogue dimension:

- The whole body shape: rails and blocks are the catalogue envelopes (WR x HR rail; W x L1 x (H - H1) steel block body with the rail channel cut out, end caps and seals to the length L); the ball grooves and the flange outline are not published as dimensions
- EGW-SB / EGW-CB through holes are drilled through the whole envelope height (the flange thickness is not published as a drilling depth; T and T1 are printed without a definition)
- The 10 mm gap between neighbouring blocks (illustration)
- Rail top chamfers and the two side ball grooves (circular approximations), block top chamfers, the end cap / end seal split of (L - L1) / 2 with its 0.5 mm inset and black plastic, and the brass grease nipple (appearance bodies and features named (appearance, approximate))
- Rail screws: SolidCraft's ISO 4762 standard part of the catalogue bolt size
- Materials and PBR looks of every body (ground top and raceway faces, satin body, plastics, brass, black oxide): SolidCraft appearance-library entries, black oxide with its own pbr
- Dust-protection, lubrication and end-cap options after + (ZZ, DD, KK change the block length L and are refused; E2, SE, RC and the like are parsed and not drawn), accuracy, preload and special E blocks / rails (recorded in the code only)
